name: akshays-framework
description: A comprehensive reconnaissance and vulnerability testing framework

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:worker
scripts.setup: npm run setup:db && npm run build
scripts.setup:db: cd packages/api && npx prisma generate && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/api && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:reset: cd packages/api && npx prisma migrate reset
scripts.install:packages: cd packages/api && npm install && cd ../web && npm install && cd ../worker && npm install

author: Akshay
